about.title: Carson Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing someone in a sudden crash leaves a Carson family with grief first and paperwork second. Carson sits in Los Angeles County, where the I-405 San Diego Freeway and the SR-91 Artesia Freeway cross through town and where Avalon Boulevard and Carson Street carry local traffic every day. Public records for 2025 list 383 injury collisions, 507 people hurt, and 2 lives lost. Behind each of those numbers is a household that has to keep going. A wrongful death claim under California law is a civil action, separate from any criminal case. It allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, and in some situations other dependents or heirs, to seek recovery for funeral and burial expenses, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that introduces Carson families to an independent attorney who handles these cases on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

whyChoose.title: Why Carson Families Start With LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who can bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell your family early on who is eligible so no one is left out or surprised later.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched from day one
items.desc: A wrongful death action must generally be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected early protects that deadline.

items.title: Losses measured the way the law allows
items.desc: Recoverable damages include funeral and burial costs, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney works on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash that killed my family member happened on the 405 in Carson. Does that change anything?
items.answer: The location matters mostly for evidence and for identifying who may be responsible. Crashes on the I-405 or SR-91 through Carson are typically documented by the CHP, while collisions on Avalon Boulevard or Carson Street are usually handled by local law enforcement, and an attorney will know where to request those records. If a public agency's road design or maintenance played a role, the filing deadline is shorter than the usual two years, so it helps to speak with someone soon.

items.question: The driver is facing criminal charges. Do we have to wait for that case to end?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action and moves separately from any criminal prosecution. The criminal case can produce useful evidence, but your two-year deadline keeps running regardless of what happens in criminal court. An attorney can coordinate the timing so your family's claim is not left behind.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm, and what does it cost to use?
items.answer: LawProactive is not a law firm and never charges families anything. We connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases, and that attorney works on contingency, meaning no fee unless there is a recovery. You are under no obligation after the introduction.
